A quick question while we wait. I've been referring to servers of this kind as model enhancement servers. What I mean by that is servers that don't wrap another service. They are standalone tools in and of themselves. Specifically, I've come across a design pattern that I really like as a standard, which is described in this file. I would like you to propose some different names for it, because model enhancement server doesn't really roll off the tongue. @.claude/skills/model-enhancement-mcp/SKILL.md
